import json, urllib.request, time
addr='0x2f689c62d83564cec6e3bd730507f4fb2200d4fe'

def submit(plan, tag):
    with urllib.request.urlopen(f'https://unitreex-test.vercel.app/api/challenge?address={addr}&free=1') as r:
        raw=json.load(r)
    ch=raw['challenge']
    body={
      "challenge": {k: ch[k] for k in ["address","nonce","missionId","issuedAt","owned","totalMinted","mintPrice","passScore","notBefore","hard","sig"]},
    }
    body["challenge"]["shareChallenge"]=ch.get("shareChallenge") or ""
    body["challenge"]["lane"]=ch.get("lane") or "paid"
    body["challenge"]["epoch"]=int(ch.get("epoch") or 0)
    body.update({"answer": json.dumps(plan), "quantity":1, "priority": False, "free": True})
    req=urllib.request.Request("https://unitreex-test.vercel.app/api/solve", data=json.dumps(body).encode(), headers={"content-type":"application/json"}, method="POST")
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req) as r:
            data=json.load(r)
    except Exception as e:
        print(tag,'ERR', getattr(e,'code',None), (e.read().decode() if hasattr(e,'read') else e)[:300])
        return
    d=data.get('detail') or {}
    print(tag, 'exact', data.get('scoreExact'), 'align', d.get('align'), 'eff', d.get('eff'), 'leading', data.get('leading'), 'leader', data.get('leader'), 'left', data.get('secondsLeft'), 'entries', data.get('entries'), 'fb', data.get('feedback'))
